name: cliff-handoff
description: Handoff layer 2 (IDE-147): when a session ends on an API error, commit the work in progress and a mechanical handoff.md on the PBI branch, push both, then pause the card: itself when this user's board credential opens the board, otherwise through a pause request in handoff.md that the next runner pass or run.py reap honours at once. No model. Best-effort and unverified until experiment 4 (docs/experiments/e4-cliff-hooks.md) runs; layer 3 in run.py is the guarantee.
composition: Copilot gets errorOccurred and sessionEnd only, never a SessionStart hook: a second SessionStart context hook can make Copilot drop both messages. The Copilot file is not registered by a plugin; copy it to ~/.copilot/hooks/ with IDP_PLATFORM_ROOT set, or print one with absolute paths: cliff_handoff.py --print-config copilot.
